resources.string: Weather Scout runs on your family\'s own server. Type its address, the same one you open in a web browser.
Type your Weather Scout address first.
That doesn\'t look like a web address. Try something like https://wx.example.com
Couldn\'t find %1$s. Check the spelling and that this phone is online (and on your VPN, if the server needs one).
%1$s didn\'t answer. Check that the server is running and reachable from this phone.
%1$s answered, but its security certificate isn\'t trusted by this phone. Weather Scout needs a real https certificate (see "HTTPS" in the README).
%1$s answered with error %2$d. Is this the right address?
%1$s answered, but it isn\'t a Weather Scout server. Check the address.
This address uses http, not https. The app will open it with a browser bar, and \"Use my location\" and alerts won\'t work. Use it anyway?
%1$s sent the app to a sign-in page, so it couldn\'t check that Weather Scout is behind it. If you sign in there in your browser, use it anyway.
Open Weather Scout to choose your server.
